name: Banana AI
description_en:
Banana AI, at Bananai.io, is an independent hosted platform for image generation, reference editing and video creation. It offers a model selection workflow rather than being the official site of the models named in its interface; the homepage explicitly states no affiliation with Google.

Choose the task and model, set dimensions or other options, generate variations and inspect the result before download. Model names, speed and quality figures on the site are vendor descriptions, not verified upstream capabilities.
description_zh:
Banana AI（Bananai.io）是独立托管图片生成、参考编辑及视频平台，提供模型选择流程；不是界面所列模型的官方网站，首页明确称与 Google 无关联。

应选任务及模型、设尺寸、生成版本并在下载前检查。模型名称、速度和质量数字均为网站描述，未核上游真实能力。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose an image/video tool and guide a creation or reference edit.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选图片/视频工具并指导生成或参考修改。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans and check-ins supply credits; cost depends on the selected operation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐/签到提供额度，消耗需看所选操作。

en: Compare background-edit variants while preserving actual product details.
zh: 比较背景修改并保护真实商品细节。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose a nonconfidential authorized photo, inspect cost before generation and compare the exported edit with the source.
steps.zh: 选非机密授权照，生成前核费用，导出后与原图比较。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Credit subscription and optional packs; model operation costs vary/unverified.

sources.title: Terms of Service
sources.research_notes_en: Upload/generated content ownership statement accompanied by license for operating, improving and promoting service; default nonrefundable fees.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Check what a reference edit actually preserves
sections.title_zh: 核参考编辑实际保留内容
sections.en: For an illustrative store image, start with an authorized product photograph and request a background change. Compare packaging, geometry, label text and shadows with the source. Do not accept pixel-preservation or near-perfect text claims without comparison. A video variant needs its own inspection for altered objects and frame-to-frame continuity.
sections.zh: 例如商店图，使用授权商品照并只改背景，对比包装、几何、标签及阴影。不能不比较就接受像素保留或近乎完美文字宣传，视频还需检查物体变化和逐帧连续。

sections.title_en: Budget credits rather than advertised image maxima
sections.title_zh: 按额度而非最高图片数预算
sections.en: Annual cards show Lite $64.68/year ($5.39/month) with 300 credits/month; Basic $143.88/1,000, Pro $287.88/2,500 and Max $575.88/6,500. Up-to image counts are not a uniform cost for all models, resolutions or video. Every card also says all models unlimited without readable qualification. Confirm operation costs, rollover, expiry and cancellations; no credit-pack amount or renewal quote was tested.
sections.zh: 年卡 Lite $64.68/折月 $5.39、月 300 额度，Basic $143.88/1,000，Pro $287.88/2,500，Max $575.88/6,500。最高图片数不代表所有模型/尺寸/视频同消耗。卡片又称全部模型不限却缺可读限定，需核操作费、结转、到期及取消。

sections.title_en: Separate a signup bonus from repeat check-in rewards
sections.title_zh: 区分注册赠额与重复签到奖励
sections.en: The homepage offers five signup credits and describes thirty credits per seven-day check-in sequence, estimating 125 potential credits/images in a month. Availability requires login and the displayed image estimate depends on operation cost. It is not an unconditional monthly entitlement or verified ongoing free capacity. Test the actual reward rules and model eligibility before planning production.
sections.zh: 首页送注册 5 额度，称每七日签到序列 30，估算每月潜在 125 额度/图片；需登录，图片估算取决消耗，不是无条件月权益或已核持续免费容量。生产前需核奖励规则和适用模型。

sections.title_en: Read the content license before private reference uploads
sections.title_zh: 私密参考上传前读内容许可
sections.en: Terms say users retain uploaded/generated content while granting the service rights to use, modify, distribute and display it for operating, improving and promoting the service. A private-generation label is therefore not a contractual no-use promise. Fees default to nonrefundable unless otherwise stated. No model, upload, check-in, video, privacy control or export was tested.
sections.zh: 条款称用户保留上传/生成内容，同时授予运营、改进及推广服务所需使用、修改、分发和展示许可。私密生成标签不是合同不使用保证；除另述外费用默认不退。本文未测模型、上传、签到、视频、隐私控制或导出。

research_gaps: No upstream model identity, quality/speed, upload, bonus, privacy or export tested.
Per-operation costs, unlimited scope, credit expiry, commercial terms, license and self-hosting unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
